## Context / Problem

Discovered from bug tapestried-oversize-blackfly. The verifier paths pin `temperature=0` for determinism (`src/rebar/llm/completion.py:396`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/floors.py:90,264`, `workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` `temperature: 0`). On Claude ≥4.7, Opus/Sonnet 5, the 5.5 family, OpenAI GPT-5.5/6.1 and Kimi K3.1 that pin is now withheld (measured rejections, 2026-11-11, Bedrock us-west-2), so those passes run at provider-default sampling. Anthropic's 5.5 migration guides say to drop temperature/top_p/top_k and steer with prompting and `output_config.effort`. Today effort is only a per-model constant in `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (`capabilities.py`, 5.5 rows: opus/sonnet `high`, haiku `medium`), sent via `anthropic_effort` and Bedrock `additionalModelRequestFields.output_config.effort` (`structured_run.py:409-417`). The operator report (suggestion 4) asks for a provider-neutral reasoning-effort surface to replace the temperature pin. A bug fix may not add config, so it is filed here.

## Approach (to be designed)

A per-pass/per-class `effort` setting mapped per provider (Anthropic `output_config.effort`, OpenAI `reasoning_effort`, Bedrock additionalModelRequestFields), with a measured determinism comparison against the old greedy pin on the plan-review replay evals.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Verifier passes can request an effort level that reaches each provider's wire field (unit tests per provider request shape).
- [ ] A replay-eval comparison of verdict stability with effort vs the old temperature pin is recorded on the ticket.
compiled_state.title: Expose a provider-neutral reasoning-effort setting for verifier passes
